display_name: List every tracked MCP bridge subprocess
description: Read-only enumeration of the tracker's registry — one row per tracked agent_instance_id with the recorded pid, an `alive` boolean (kill -0 probe at list time), and the original spawn timestamp. Used by the iTerm2 plugin's `terminate_session` joseki resolvers to disambiguate tabs, by the FSEvents watcher when `<solet>.bridge.port` changes (iterate + restart each), and by operator-side diagnostics. Touches no state. Empty bridges tuple is a valid steady state — no tabs open means no bridges tracked.
embedding_description: Inspect the live MCP bridge subprocess registry to discover which agent_instance_id values are tracked + whether each bridge is alive. Returns BridgeListResult: tuple of BridgeStatus rows (agent_instance_id, solet_name, pid, alive, started_at) + count summary. Use before terminate_bridge/restart_bridge to confirm target exists; also for operator debug to spot orphaned entries (alive=false).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeListResult frozen dataclass carrying a tuple of BridgeStatus rows (agent_instance_id, solet_name, pid, alive, started_at) plus a count summary in the message field.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the row count. For each row surface agent_instance_id + pid + alive + started_at. When alive=false on a row, call that out — the tracking entry is stale and the operator may want to clean it via terminate_bridge (which is idempotent against not_running).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Enumerate every tracked MCP bridge subprocess.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: tracker_unavailable: the plugin is not in the ready state yet (prepare_for_readiness has not completed). This is a transient startup-window error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: tracker_unavailable: wait for solet startup to finish (poll list_plugins for status=ready on the macos_coding_agent_session_plugin entry) and retry.
